NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fly Anatolia records your flight track with GPS while you fly.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Fly Anatolia keeps recording your flight when the screen is locked. Choose “Always” so a flight is not cut off.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Fly Anatolia uses the barometer for an accurate climb rate (vario).
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fly Anatolia lets you add a photo to a notice or a chat message.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Fly Anatolia lets you take a photo for a notice or a chat message.
